# Fenwright

> CRA vulnerability response for makers of connected products.

Fenwright helps mid-sized manufacturers (50 to 249 staff) of connected products meet the EU Cyber
Resilience Act's reporting rules. We build a software bill of materials (SBOM) for each product,
watch actively exploited vulnerability feeds every day, check whether each one affects the product,
and draft the Article 14 reports (24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification, final report). The
manufacturer approves every report and submits it on ENISA's Single Reporting Platform. The Assured
plan adds evening, weekend and bank-holiday cover and, for manufacturers that report through Ireland,
submitting approved reports on their behalf.

- [Homepage](https://www.fenwright.ie/): what we do, the free first look, how it works
- [About](https://www.fenwright.ie/#about): who runs Fenwright
- [Security](https://www.fenwright.ie/security): how to report a vulnerability to us
- [Privacy](https://www.fenwright.ie/privacy): privacy policy and data handling

Contact: contact@fenwright.ie
